metadata.question: Has the nighttime light intensity in Houston decreased on May 18, 2024, compared to the average intensity in April 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 (daily nighttime lights) - Band: DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m - Location: Houston, Texas (approximately 29.76°N, 95.37°W) - Time periods: * April 2024 (for average): '2024-04-01' to '2024-04-30' * May 18, 2024 (specific date): '2024-05-18' to '2024-05-19' 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS nighttime lights typically don't require cloud masking like optical data - However, should check for quality flags if available - Focus on DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: NTL can legitimately be 0 or very low (dark areas) - Check collection size first (C1 if empty) - Check pixel counts after processing (C2 if 0 valid pixels) - Compare April average vs May 18 value - If either value is None/NaN → C3 - If May 18 < April average → A (decreased) - Otherwise → B (not decreased) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.37, 29.76]).buffer(20000) # 20km buffer around Houston # 2. Data Acquisition & Check # April 2024 average col_april = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \ .filterDate('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30') \ .filterBounds(houston) \ .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m') april_size = col_april.size().getInfo() print(f"April 2024 images found: {april_size}") if april_size == 0: print("No data for April 2024.") print("C1") exit() # May 18, 2024 specific date col_may18 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \ .filterDate('2024-05-18', '2024-05-19') \ .filterBounds(houston) \ .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m') may18_size = col_may18.size().getInfo() print(f"May 18, 2024 images found: {may18_size}") if may18_size == 0: print("No data for May 18, 2024.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Processing # Calculate April average img_april = col_april.mean() # Get May 18 image img_may18 = col_may18.first() # 4. Check valid pixels and calculate statistics # April average april_stats = img_april.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=houston, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() april_mean = april_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_mean') april_count = april_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_count') print(f"April 2024 - Mean: {april_mean}, Valid pixels: {april_count}") if april_count == 0: print("No valid pixels for April 2024.") print("C2") exit() # May 18 statistics may18_stats = img_may18.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=houston, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ).getInfo() may18_mean = may18_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_mean') may18_count = may18_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_count') print(f"May 18, 2024 - Mean: {may18_mean}, Valid pixels: {may18_count}") if may18_count == 0: print("No valid pixels for May 18, 2024.") print("C2") exit() # 5. Validation & Final Answer if april_mean is None or may18_mean is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid values.") print("C3") elif may18_mean < april_mean: print(f"Decrease detected: {may18_mean:.4f} < {april_mean:.4f}") print("A") else: print(f"No decrease: {may18_mean:.4f} >= {april_mean:.4f}") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.37, 29.76]).buffer(20000)  # 20km buffer around Houston

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
# April 2024 average
col_april = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \
    .filterDate('2024-04-01', '2024-04-30') \
    .filterBounds(houston) \
    .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m')

april_size = col_april.size().getInfo()
print(f"April 2024 images found: {april_size}")

if april_size == 0:
    print("No data for April 2024.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# May 18, 2024 specific date
col_may18 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \
    .filterDate('2024-05-18', '2024-05-19') \
    .filterBounds(houston) \
    .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m')

may18_size = col_may18.size().getInfo()
print(f"May 18, 2024 images found: {may18_size}")

if may18_size == 0:
    print("No data for May 18, 2024.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing
# Calculate April average
img_april = col_april.mean()

# Get May 18 image
img_may18 = col_may18.first()

# 4. Check valid pixels and calculate statistics
# April average
april_stats = img_april.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=houston,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

april_mean = april_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_mean')
april_count = april_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_count')

print(f"April 2024 - Mean: {april_mean}, Valid pixels: {april_count}")

if april_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for April 2024.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# May 18 statistics
may18_stats = img_may18.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=houston,
    scale=3000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

may18_mean = may18_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_mean')
may18_count = may18_stats.get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m_count')

print(f"May 18, 2024 - Mean: {may18_mean}, Valid pixels: {may18_count}")

if may18_count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for May 18, 2024.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if april_mean is None or may18_mean is None:
    print("Calculation failed - invalid values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif may18_mean < april_mean:
    print(f"Decrease detected: {may18_mean:.4f} < {april_mean:.4f}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"No decrease: {may18_mean:.4f} >= {april_mean:.4f}")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
